info.title: API.SH: habitaclia
info.description: The habitaclia API from API.SH: public habitaclia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The estate agencies working in a place on habitaclia, with each agency's business details (name, legal name, logo, website, phone, e-mail, address, coordinates, description, registrations) and its listing counts and price range by transaction and property type. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/habitaclia-agencies

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place name; the best match is used. Or pass location_code.

parameters.name: page

get.description:
One habitaclia listing: everything in a search result plus the full description, the place tree and the listing's products; price history, coordinates, photos, videos, tours, energy rating and the agency's business details. A private seller's name and contact are never returned. Pass `id`, `url` or `latest=true` with search params.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/habitaclia-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (a UUID from search results).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A habitaclia.com listing link ending in /<id>/d, or a /a/<id> short link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: return the newest current listing of a search with the search params given alongside (keeps examples valid). Then id/url are not needed.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With latest=true: place for the search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Homes, offices, commercial premises, industrial buildings, land, garages and buildings for sale, rent or transfer, and new homes, on habitaclia (Spain), with the site's filters: place, price, area, rooms, bathrooms, features, property subtypes, private sellers only, bank-owned, new-build, and sorts. Each result has id, link, reference, title, transaction, property type and subtype, price, price history and change, price per m², rooms, bathrooms, area, floor, year built, condition, features (present and absent), energy rating, address, ZIP, city, district, province, coordinates, photos, videos, virtual tours, publication and update dates, and the agency with its business details (name, legal name, logo, website, phone, e-mail, address, registrations). A private seller is shown as `{private: true}` with no name or contact. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/habitaclia-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place name (city, district, province...); the best match is used. Or pass location_code.

parameters.name: area_min
parameters.description: Minimum built area (land area for land), m².

parameters.name: area_max
parameters.description: Maximum built area (land area for land), m².

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Features, comma-separated, e.g. ELEVATOR, TERRACE, POOL, PRIVATE_PARKING, PRIVATE_GARDEN, AIR_CONDITIONER, FURNISHED, UNFURNISHED, STORAGE_ROOM, BALCONY, NEARBY_PUBLIC_TRANSPORT.

parameters.name: property_subtype
parameters.description: Subtypes, comma-separated, e.g. FLAT, APARTMENT, PENTHOUSE, DUPLEX, GROUND_FLOOR, STUDIO, LOFT, CHALET, TERRACED_HOUSE, PAIRED_HOUSE, RUSTIC_HOUSE.

parameters.name: new_build
parameters.description: true: new-build only; false: resale only.

parameters.name: agency_id
parameters.description: Only this agency's listings (agency.id of a result).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page (1 = first). Pass `next_page` back here.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
